headline: Back to normal after a power cut

items.title: The volume ring stays off the screen
items.text: Turning the volume ring no longer types stray characters onto a monitor connected over HDMI.

items.title: The right time after a power cut
items.text: After a power cut the Q keeps the time it had instead of falling back to the year 2000 until it reaches the internet.

items.title: No lost health record
items.text: The first health record after a power cut is no longer lost with the one the cut interrupted.
